exports.name: usePeaks
exports.contract: (audioUrl, audioEl, suppliedPeaks?) -> number[]|null; 2026-07-10 (task 008): a non-empty suppliedPeaks short-circuits the fetch+decode effect entirely and is returned directly (no network/AudioContext) -- lets PlayerBar feed a server-computed peaks sidecar for over-cap clips. Existing behavior unchanged when suppliedPeaks is omitted.

exports.name: computeTapeBarCount
exports.contract: re-exported from waveformTapeZoomPresets.ts (moved there 2026-07-11 to break the minimap import cycle)

notes: usePeaks decoupled from the <audio> element (fetch+decode independent of audioEl.src) -- preserves ADR-0010 single-audio-owner; no <audio> or MediaElementSourceNode anywhere in this file (grep-confirmed)
fixed-grid sampling (audio-player.md 1.6.0 §5.3): gridSec = windowSec/BAR_COUNT, alignedStart snapped -- prevents waveform crawl

task 007 landed 2026-07-04: accepts optional onZoomChange/peaks props, renders WaveformTapeZoom above and WaveformTapeMinimap below the canvas when onZoomChange is provided; still not yet mounted into PlayerBar.tsx -- that's task 008's job

review-ratchet fix (2026-07-04): wheel-zoom listener is attached via a native, non-passive addEventListener('wheel', ..., {passive:false}) in a useEffect, not React's onWheel JSX prop -- React registers wheel as passive at the root (17+), so e.preventDefault() inside onWheel was a silent no-op in real browsers (page scrolled while zoom also snapped); jsdom couldn't reproduce the bug, so the regression test is structural (asserts the addEventListener call's options)

2026-07-10 adversarial-review fix (CRITICAL): minimapPeaks previously read the raw `peaks` prop (`peaks !== undefined ? peaks : peakArray`), which is null for every under-cap clip (PlayerBar passes peaks={sidecarPeaks}, only non-null over the duration cap) -- the minimap rendered flat placeholder bars while the canvas correctly showed the decoded waveform. Fixed: minimapPeaks = peakArray (usePeaks' already-resolved effective source), used by both canvas and minimap.

2026-07-11 waveform fixes: detail-canvas bar count now computeTapeBarCount(availablePeaks,duration,windowSec,containerWidthPx) instead of a fixed 180 (scales resolution with zoom width); playhead position driven by a 60Hz requestAnimationFrame loop in BOTH paged and moving modes (was ~4Hz timeupdate in paged, which stepped). computeTapeBarCount moved out to waveformTapeZoomPresets.ts and re-exported here.
